analysis.title: quality x momentum [issue #30]: buy biopharma and LULU
key_insights: The GS FICC & Equities desk (Shreya Kumar, Mark Wilson) runs weekly quality and momentum screens to find well-timed entries into high-quality stocks, and highlights stocks with improving momentum and upcoming catalysts every two weeks.
Issue #30 buy ideas: biopharma (Amgen, Argenx) and Lululemon.

Biopharma: Amgen is at 12-month relative highs (momentum) and rated on profitability and growth (quality). Argenx has EPS upgrades (momentum) and is on the GS Conviction List, with capital allocation, profitability and growth (quality).
The desk says biopharma outperforms as the market rotates out of the AI value chain.
Expectations remain robust into Amgen results on 3 Nov, on continued commercial momentum and strong pipeline execution.
Lululemon: 1-month momentum breakout, quality screen on capital allocation. Stock makes 1-month relative highs after positively received leadership changes.
Lululemon's next catalyst is F3Q26 earnings on 11 December, where investors will look for CEO Maggie Gauger's initial priorities on product, brand, customer experience and margins.
Track record of prior issues: issue #29 top picks Valero -14% and RELX +2%; issue #28 SIKA -7%, Puig +5%; issue #27 Enel -8%, Novonesis +10%.
